mockups.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity Simplified Chinese Windows desktop application screen for PrintFlow Studio, wide 16:10, straight-on, edge to edge.
Input image: supplied PrintFlow Studio workbench is a design-system and layout reference. Match its native WPF-style title bar, pale mint, white and muted grey surfaces, deep teal #007F6B action color, thin borders, slightly rounded controls, compact Noto Sans SC style. Preserve the three-column editing layout and overall desktop proportions. Do not reuse personal names or decorative concept labels from the reference.
Primary request: show the AI design prompt workbench just after one returned image was verified and imported. Title bar “PrintFlow Studio”. Header “AI 设计提示词”, quiet top navigation buttons “返回首页”, “已保存的提示词草稿”, and at far right a quiet “AI 任务” entry. Below, native tabs “快速生成” and “详细核对”. Upper body, three balanced white panes with the headers “常用模板”, “本次信息”, and “本次提示词”. Keep the form legible and restrained: selected “人物纪念 T 恤”, plus “圆形纪念徽章” and “只改姓名日期”; the middle pane shows small blue-triangle thumbnails labeled “人物参考” and “版式参考”; the prompt editor holds one short line “将蓝色三角形改为红色，保留白色背景。” Use ample empty room in editor.
The key design change is a broad anchored results card immediately above the bottom action strip, well separated from the editing panes by spacing. It takes about a quarter of the screen height and can always be seen without scrolling. Card heading “回传结果”. Below, show exactly ONE striking thumbnail, an upright solid red equilateral triangle centered on white, with a clean thin border, synthetic simple matching the example. Next to it show “红色三角形”, “PNG · 1254 × 1254”, and a restrained success indicator “已导入”. On its own line show four chronological step labels with checkmarked nodes connected by a fine line, “已提交”, “已回传”, “已核验”, “已导入” with final state in teal. Right-align the only filled teal call to action on the card, “继续处理”, with a small secondary hint “进入原图确认” directly below. Keep the preview and CTA distinct and obvious. At the bottom of the app, right aligned compact outline buttons “保存草稿”, “复制提示词”, “自动生图”.
Text: use exactly the Simplified Chinese labels specified and spell them correctly. Use a clean left-to-right grid and realistic dense-but-readable desktop UI. A single clean application window, no backdrop, no perspective, no browser, no dialog, no annotation arrows, no percentages, no graphs, no extra tagline, no heading outside the app, no duplicate result cards and no watermark. Nothing outside the app frame.
mockups.finalEditPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Precise local edit to the supplied complete PrintFlow Studio screenshot (edit target). Preserve the desktop chrome, dimensions, colors, all card graphics, typography, layout, spacing, red triangle thumbnail, progress and buttons. Only in the middle column under “本次信息”, change the first two compact labels to the existing app’s exact “姓名（保留原文）” and “出生日期（可留空）”, leave both of these input boxes empty. Keep each box in exactly the same place. Everything else is pixel-stable, especially the entire “回传结果” area including “继续处理” and “进入原图确认”. Output the complete 16:10 screenshot uncut. Efficient image edit, no restyling.

mockups.initialPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity Simplified Chinese Windows desktop application screen for PrintFlow Studio, wide landscape 16:10, straight-on, edge to edge.
Input image: supplied existing PrintFlow Studio workbench is visual style reference only. Carry over the WPF-style title bar, the printer icon, white and pale mint surfaces, subtle grey borders, modest corner radii, dark text and deep teal #007F6B controls. Use readable native Noto Sans SC style. This new page is a quiet, compact task history utility.
Primary request: design a new “AI 任务” list screen for a user who generally runs one generation at a time and occasionally retrieves older outputs. Heading “AI 任务” with quiet “返回工作台” navigation and “返回首页” at the top. Under the heading a short segmented filter row: “全部”, “进行中”, “需处理”, with “全部” selected. Then a single broad bordered list with real table columns “任务”, “状态”, “更新时间”, “操作”; three rows and visible, substantial whitespace under them. No sidebar, no analytics, no bulk selection, no separate detail pane.
Row 1, one active task only: square neutral outline image placeholder in first column, “版式测试”; a quiet teal-blue status “已回传，待核验” with a small second line “收到图片 · 等待来源核验”, timestamp “今天 11:05”, action “查看 Work 会话” as outline button. This row should read as the newest.
Row 2, finished task: thumbnail of one solid red equilateral triangle centered on pure white; “红色三角形” with “PNG · 1254 × 1254”; green status “已导入”, timestamp “今天 11:01”; action “继续处理” in filled dark teal. Make this button the page's only prominent primary action.
Row 3, historical failure: neutral square image placeholder, “参考图测试”; amber status “参考图上传失败”, timestamp “今天 10:33”, final action “查看详情” outline. Separate rows with thin borders; align all times and buttons. Use a comfortable native desktop content width, gutters and compact rows, with the visual rhythm of the reference. The navigation connects back to the workbench and home. Never add a fourth row, multiple active jobs, decorative stats, branding outside title bar, fictitious filenames, filler badges, or app chrome outside the window frame. Make all specified Simplified Chinese strings accurate, especially “已回传，待核验” and “继续处理”.
mockups.finalEditPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Local retouch of the supplied PrintFlow Studio AI 任务 list mockup (edit target). Remove the mint-outlined “交互设计稿 · 概念示意” badge next to “PrintFlow Studio” in the title bar. Fill that specific area with the existing pale mint background. Keep every other element intact and at the same location, including buttons “返回首页”, “返回工作台”, “查看 Work 会话”, “继续处理”, “查看详情”, and the exact three task row statuses and triangle. Output the full wide screenshot, no cropping, no new labels, no restyling.
